activities.programming: Write a small program, test different inputs, and explain how the solution works.
activities.database management: Create related tables and write queries to retrieve and combine records.
activities.networking: Practise setting up a small network and checking connectivity.
activities.web development: Build a small responsive page and check its layout and form behaviour.
activities.cybersecurity: Use a course-provided scenario to identify security risks and explain suitable safeguards.
activities.cloud: Use a course-provided cloud lab to deploy a small application and check its access permissions.
activities.devops: Create a test-and-build pipeline for a sample project and investigate a failed run.
activities.operating systems: Use a practice environment to organise files, inspect running processes, and check file permissions.
activities.version control: Create a practice repository, make changes on a branch, and resolve a sample merge conflict.
activities.tools: Use a tool from your course to complete one task and document the steps so a peer can repeat them.
activities.design: Sketch a user flow, create a wireframe, and ask a peer to try a task using your design.
activities.data analytics: Clean a small sample dataset, create a chart, and explain what the results do and do not show.
activities.quality assurance: Write test cases for a sample feature, try normal and unexpected inputs, and document a reproducible defect.
activities.technical support: Work through a simulated support request, record your troubleshooting steps, and explain how you checked the solution.
activities.video editing: Edit a short practice sequence, synchronise its audio, add captions, and check the exported video.
activities.image editing: Edit a practice image using layers, adjust its colour and crop, and compare the original with the exported result.
activities.photography: Take a practice set of photos with different exposure settings and explain how lighting and composition affect the result.
activities.videography: Plan and record a short practice scene, checking framing, camera stability, lighting, and recorded audio.
activities.graphic design: Create a poster from a sample brief and review its typography, alignment, contrast, and visual hierarchy.
activities.multimedia production: Storyboard a short presentation combining images, audio, and video, then check the finished export.
activities.audio editing: Trim a practice recording, balance its audio levels, add fades, and listen to the exported result.
activities.animation: Storyboard and animate a short sequence with keyframes, then adjust its timing and review the rendered result.
activities.accounting: Use fictional transactions to prepare journal entries and a trial balance, then check them against the sample source documents.
activities.bookkeeping: Record fictional receipts and payments in a ledger and reconcile the balances with sample source documents.
activities.spreadsheet skills: Build a worksheet from sample data, check its formulas, and use sorting, filtering, and a chart to explain the results.
activities.office productivity: Prepare a formatted document, a summary worksheet, and a short presentation for a fictional office task.
activities.data entry: Enter sample records from a practice form, check for missing values and duplicates, and verify them against the source.
activities.records management: Organise fictional documents into a labelled filing system, create an index, and test retrieving the correct version.
activities.inventory management: Use sample stock receipts and issues to update an inventory register and reconcile it with a practice stock count.
activities.business communication: Draft an email and meeting summary for a fictional workplace situation, then proofread them for clarity, tone, and completeness.
activities.mobile development: Build a small mobile screen with navigation and form input, then check its behaviour at different device sizes.
activities.system administration: In a course-provided lab, create a test user, set file permissions, and check service logs.
activities.technical documentation: Write a short guide for a practice task and ask a peer to follow it, then revise any unclear or missing steps.
activities.social media management: Create a sample content calendar and draft posts for a fictional organisation, then explain how you would review engagement.
activities.computer hardware: Use a training device or diagram to identify components and explain a step-by-step hardware troubleshooting sequence.
